title: Sphere holds 15 ft from a friend's cockpit at Pax River

tellings.quote: fascinating case with one of my good friends who had basically a sphere pull up about 15 feet from his cockpit while he's, you know, maneuvering pretty quickly and hang out there for about 20

plain: Ryan Graves, a US Navy fighter pilot, tells a podcast about a case involving one of his good friends at Patuxent River, a naval air base in Maryland usually called Pax River. According to Graves, while his friend was flying and turning hard, a sphere pulled up about 15 feet from his cockpit and stayed there with him for a while. If true, it would mean something unknown can keep pace with a fighter jet at close range.
